_criterion: Titles of Dungan Wikipedia (Wp/dng) incubator articles in tests/data/dungan_wikipedia.json whose SUBJECT is a religious concept, figure, text, institution, feast or ritual object. The assignment is by title and was made by hand; it is shipped so the figure reported in the paper can be audited and disagreed with. Deliberately EXCLUDED, to keep the set conservative: toponyms that are merely biblical settings (Галилея, Иордан, Иудея, Ханаан, Самария, Синай Сан, Хорив, Либан, Египет), ethnonyms and gentilics (Филистимжынму, Халдейжынму, Хеттейжынму, Грекжынму, Яхўти), rulers and officials known from the New Testament narrative but not themselves religious subjects (Видади Ирод, Ирод Агриппа II, Ирод Антипа, Пилат, Тиберий, Август), and coins and measures attested in scripture (Динарий, Лепта, Кодрант, Шекель Йинчян). Including any of those groups raises the share; the number reported is therefore a lower bound.
_note: Мусади Фалү and Мусади фалү are two separate articles in the source dump, differing only in the capitalisation of the second word; both are retained because both contribute tokens.
